name: IVR
tagline: International Association for Inland Waterway Transport Representation
hero_kpi_rationale: Organisation à but non lucratif représentant les intérêts du secteur européen du transport fluvial. Les KPI financiers traditionnels ne s'appliquent pas. L'engagement des membres (225 participants au congrès 2024, 11 pays) et l'activité d'organisation d'événements sectoriels reflètent mieux la valeur créée.

kpis.signal: Strong member participation and international representation across 11 countries
kpis.description: Le congrès annuel IVR 2024 (15-17 mai à Francfort) a accueilli 225 participants en provenance de 11 pays européens, démontrant un engagement fort du secteur.

kpis.explanation: Number of distinct countries with representation in the association's governance and activities.
kpis.signal: Pan-European presence and international reach in inland waterway transport sector
kpis.description: Le congrès 2024 a rassemblé des représentants de 11 pays européens différents, consolidant le positionnement international de l'IVR.

company_description: Wärtsilä Oyj Abp offers technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets worldwide. It offers energy storage; engine and hybrid power plants; and data centre power solutions, as well as lifecycle solutions, lifecycle upgrades, spare parts and field services, and decarbonisation solutions. It also provides engine power plant products, such as gas, multi-fuel, and diesel engines; Quantum BESS portfolio, a battery energy storage system (BESS) solutions; GEMS Digital Energy Platform, a software platform that monitors, controls, and optimizes energy assets on site and portfolio levels. In addition, the company offers power and propulsion products, such as electric shipping and hybrid ships, engine and generating sets, propulsors and gears, and shaft line solutions; liquid and gas handling products, including ballast water management, freshwater generation, waste and wastewater treatment, gas solutions, and exhaust treatment equipment; port and fleet optimization; simulation and training solutions; and marine navigation solutions.
